---
title: "Pressure QC (AR)"
description: |
  Basic analysis of the pressure QC data from the Arctic Ocean in situ NRT observations.
---

```{r include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE)

# Common functions
library(reportlib)
r_func_path <- "./_func"
r_funcs <- c("common_site.Rmd", "common_ar.Rmd")

# Variables
var <- "pres"
qc_var <- "pres_qc"
qc_var_name <- "Pressure QC flag"
```

```{r, import, child=file.path(r_func_path, r_funcs)}
```

```{r, location_filtering, include = FALSE}
src <- knitr::knit_expand(template_path("location_filtering.Rmd"), df=df_name, df_filtered=df_filtered_name)
res <- knitr::knit_child(text = src, quiet = TRUE)
```

## 1. Basic Information

```{r, basic_info, results = 'asis'}
cat(res, sep = '\n')
```
